verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.
“Mendicants, live with training as benefit, with wisdom as overseer, with freedom as core, and with mindfulness as ruler.

verses.pali: Sikkhānisaṁsānaṁ, bhikkhave, viharataṁ paññuttarānaṁ vimuttisārānaṁ satādhipateyyānaṁ dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: A mendicant who lives in this way can expect one of two results:

verses.pali: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
verses.english: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
“The training fulfilled, not liable to decline,
overseen by wisdom, seer of rebirth’s end;
that sage bears their final body;
they have disposed of Māra, I declare, <j>and gone beyond old age.
Therefore be always enjoying absorption, <j>immersed in samādhi,
Having overcome Māra and his armies, mendicants,

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
